evidence.reason: This is a verification-hardening proposal for an ops test harness, not a demonstrated implementation defect. The supplied region shows the harness already cross-validates the payload record's completions against the final durable completion log (completions_after via after_by_invocation, lines 2519-2532), in addition to checking count/uniqueness/sequence advance (2509-2518) and record-set difference (2533-2540). The on-disk record (record_after) is identity- and outcome-matched to the payload (2541-2544). Nothing in the supplied source shows the retained journal is the only durable completion evidence or that the on-disk record can omit completions while passing; the finding's premise is an unestablished assumption. Asking the harness to additionally assert completions in the on-disk record and journal identity in stdout enlarges verification/protection scope rather than repairing broken intended behavior. The current contract does not impose this specific check on the ops script, and an opportunity to strengthen the harness does not itself establish a defect. The duplicated reference to 2666-2667 is the same request.
